catalogue.title: Overseas Trade Statistics API (uktradeinfo)
catalogue.notes: Monthly UK imports by CN8 commodity and recorded partner. Partner = country of dispatch, which may differ from where goods were grown. Imports valued CIF (statistical value; Intrastat EU trade uses invoice value). Net mass in kg; about a third of Intrastat goods need no weight declaration and are estimated. Provisional for up to 18 months after publication. Series breaks: EU exit (Jan 2021) and customs-based GB–EU import collection (Jan 2022).

catalogue.title: UK import trade in goods by country of origin and country of dispatch, 2024
catalogue.notes: Context only (Evidence page caveat on the Netherlands dispatch effect). Not used for figures: it covers only trade where both origin and dispatch were declared.

catalogue.title: United Kingdom Food Security Report 2024, theme 3 (food supply chain resilience): chart data
catalogue.publisher: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs
catalogue.notes: Theme 3 dataset FSR-theme3-241211.ods: 3_2_2a food, feed and drink imports by port of entry (2022, 2023), 3_2_2b Short Straits share by food group, 3_2_1a average delay on England's Strategic Road Network. Values as published; next report due December 2027.

catalogue.title: Defra trade codes and descriptions (Food statistics in your pocket)
catalogue.publisher: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs (Defra)
catalogue.notes: ODS of 15 Nov 2022: 8,031 commodity codes with Defra's groupings (SITC division, FFD, Brigades), indigeneity and degree of processing. Used to check the sixteen baskets against Defra's own groupings (gate G3) and to state which baskets Defra classes as not grown in the UK (non-indigenous).

catalogue.title: Horticulture statistics 2025
catalogue.publisher: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs
catalogue.notes: Accompanying dataset hort-dataset-25-20260625.ods (published 25 June 2026): tomatoes (Table 23), strawberries and apples (Table 12) — home production marketed, imports, exports, total supply and home production as a share of supply, calendar years. Annual national context only; Defra's trade figures use its own product definitions (fresh produce where distinguishable), not the Food Origins baskets.

catalogue.title: Agriculture in the United Kingdom 2025, chapter 7: crops
catalogue.publisher: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs
catalogue.notes: Datasets AUK-chapter7-20260709.ods (published 9 July 2026, updated 3 September 2026): wheat (Table 7.2c), potatoes (Table 7.10c) and all sugar on a refined basis (Table 7.6b); and AUK-chapter8-20260709i.ods (poultry revised 3 September 2026): beef and veal (Table 8.2d), mutton and lamb (Table 8.4d) and poultry meat (Table 8.5d), in dressed carcase weight equivalent. Supply and use, with production as a percentage of total new supply; 2025 (wheat, potatoes and sugar provisional). Annual national context only.

catalogue.title: Grocery Retail Points (v46, June 2026)
catalogue.licence: GEOLYTIX open data, no named licence ("completely free and open to use data")
catalogue.notes: Store locations, retailer, fascia and size band as delivered (provided by John, 24 Oct 2026). Class from size_band (convenience under 280 m², supermarket 280 m² and over); forecourt, motorway, travel and hospital formats flagged; wholesale and mainly non-food stores left out (decision D5). Retail presence only: no turnover, prices or opening hours.

catalogue.title: Priority Places for Food Index v2.1
catalogue.publisher: Consumer Data Research Centre / Leeds Healthy & Sustainable Places Data Service
catalogue.notes: Ranks and deciles within each nation (England 33,755 LSOAs, Wales 1,917, Scotland 6,976 Data Zones (2011), Northern Ireland 890 SOAs 2011) for the combined index and seven domains; three domains have no Northern Ireland data. Decile 1 = highest priority: the publisher's documentation does not state the direction; it was checked against the deprivation indices. Never compared across nations. File provided by John (HASP download, 25 Oct 2026).

catalogue.title: Local Authority Districts (May 2025) Boundaries UK (BGC for display, BFE for store assignment)
catalogue.notes: Source: Office for National Statistics licensed under the Open Government Licence v.3.0. Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2025. 361 councils; display edition generalised to 20 m, clipped to the coastline and further simplified for the web.

catalogue.title: LSOA 2021 boundaries, population-weighted centroids and lookup (England and Wales)
catalogue.notes: Lower layer Super Output Areas (December 2021) BGC V5, population-weighted centroids V4 and the LSOA 2021 → ward 2025 → council 2025 lookup, for the Manchester deep profile; the lookup for every LSOA assigns the Priority Places index to councils in England and Wales (Stage 6); every LSOA's population-weighted centroid locates the small areas of the Scenario Lab's supermarket-closure scenario (Stage 7). Source: Office for National Statistics licensed under the Open Government Licence v.3.0. Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2025.

catalogue.title: Data Zones 2021 and population-weighted centroids
catalogue.publisher: Northern Ireland Statistics and Research Agency
catalogue.notes: 3,780 Data Zones (Irish Grid TM65, EPSG:29902) and their Census 2021 population-weighted centroids, for the Belfast deep profile and the Scenario Lab's supermarket-closure scenario (Stage 7). Contains Ordnance Survey of Northern Ireland information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

catalogue.title: Data Zone Centroids 2022 (Scotland)
catalogue.notes: Population-weighted centroids of Scotland's 7,392 2022 Data Zones (EPSG:27700) with Census 2022 total population (cell-key perturbed, so sums may differ from published totals), for the Scenario Lab's supermarket-closure scenario (Stage 7). Copyright Scottish Government, contains Ordnance Survey data © Crown copyright and database right 2024.

catalogue.title: Population estimates for the UK, England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland: mid-2025
catalogue.publisher: Office for National Statistics (with NRS and NISRA)
catalogue.notes: Usual residents at 30 June 2025 for all four nations (accredited official statistics), on council boundaries of April 2024; land area excluding inland water (Standard Area Measurements, January 2025; NISRA for Northern Ireland). Barnsley and Sheffield figures predate their 2025 boundary change.

catalogue.title: Deprivation indices: English Indices of Deprivation 2025; Northern Ireland Multiple Deprivation Measure 2017
catalogue.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government; NISRA
catalogue.notes: IoD 2025 File 7 (England, LSOA 2021, ranks and deciles within England); NIMDM 2017 (Northern Ireland, SOA 2011, ranks within Northern Ireland; deciles derived, 89 SOAs each). Each index ranks areas within its own nation only and they are never compared.

catalogue.title: Car or van availability (Census 2021)
catalogue.notes: England and Wales: TS045 (households by number of cars or vans), councils and LSOAs. Northern Ireland: NISRA flexible table builder HH_CAR_VAN_TC5 by Data Zone and council (files from John). Census day 21 March 2021. Scotland (Census 2022) not included.

catalogue.title: Rural–urban classifications
catalogue.notes: England and Wales: ONS 2021 Rural Urban Classification of councils (LAD 2024) and LSOAs (2021). Northern Ireland: NISRA 2015 default urban/rural class per SOA (from the NIMDM 2017 file; no council-level class, no Census 2021-based edition). Scotland not included. Classifications differ by nation and are never compared.

catalogue.title: Port freight annual statistics 2025 (PORT0499, PORT0304, major and minor port list)
catalogue.notes: Accredited official statistics. PORT0499: major-port tonnage by year (2000-2025), direction, cargo group and category, and region and country of the port of load or unload; reconciled with PORT0304 for 2025. The port list gives UN/LOCODEs, nations and a rough map location for 27 of 53 statistical ports. Tonnage of all cargo: only 'agricultural products (eg grain, soya, tapioca)' is food- or feed-related; unitised traffic (containers, roll-on/roll-off) is not recorded by commodity.

catalogue.title: Natural Earth Admin 0 countries (1:110m outlines, 1:50m label points)
catalogue.notes: v5.1.2 GeoJSON from the Natural Earth repository (tag v5.1.2), pinned by SHA-256. ISO_A2_EH is the join key to HMRC CountryCodeAlpha (gate G4). Label points are Natural Earth's own LABEL_X/LABEL_Y, used as the symbolic start of import connections. Reference geometry only; boundaries are not an endorsement.

catalogue.title: ArcGIS Basemap styles service
catalogue.licence: Esri terms of use; attribution rendered by the SDK
catalogue.notes: Dark grey style (arcgis/dark-gray), used when an ArcGIS API key is configured (Actions secret ARCGIS_API_KEY). Loads on the live site (post-deploy smoke test, 23 Oct 2026); not reachable from the build sandbox.

catalogue.title: Food hygiene rating open data (Northern Ireland councils)
catalogue.notes: Register of food businesses for the 11 Northern Ireland councils; used only to show grocers that GEOLYTIX does not map (supplementary layer, never counted in rates). A registration is not proof of a grocery offer or opening hours.

catalogue.title: Level of water stress (SDG 6.4.2), FAO AQUASTAT, through the World Bank API
catalogue.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (AQUASTAT); World Bank (World Development Indicators)
catalogue.notes: Freshwater withdrawal as a percentage of available freshwater resources, by country; latest year 2022 (2021 for two countries). FAO's SDG 6.4.2 classes: no stress below 25 %, low, medium, high, critical above 100 %. A national figure for the whole country; it does not describe the growing region, season or irrigation of any import.

catalogue.title: Structure of the agricultural industry in England and the UK at June: England regions and UK key results by country
catalogue.publisher: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs
catalogue.notes: June 2025 survey results: wheat area, cattle, sheep, pigs and poultry for the 8 Defra regions of England (commercial holdings; London counted with the South East) and for Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland (each country's own survey or census). England's regional cattle (commercial holdings) total less than the all-holdings England figure.

catalogue.title: Data Zone Lookups 2011 and 2022 (Scotland)
catalogue.notes: Assigns Scotland's 6,976 2011 Data Zones (the geography of the Priority Places index in Scotland) and 7,392 2022 Data Zones (the Scenario Lab's small areas, Stage 7) to the 32 current councils. Windows-1252 text.

catalogue.title: International Territorial Level 1 (January 2025) Boundaries UK BGC
catalogue.notes: 12 ITL1 regions (EPSG:27700), used to draw Defra's agricultural statistics regions (London merged with the South East) and the three devolved countries. Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2025.

catalogue.title: OS Open Roads (Great Britain)
catalogue.notes: GeoPackage (about 1 GB) processed on GitHub Actions: motorways and trunk roads ('strategic': the national highway authorities' networks) and other primary-route A roads ('primary'), merged by road number and simplified at 60 m. Great Britain only. Road corridors, not freight flows. Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right.

catalogue.title: EMODnet Human Activities, Main ports: port locations
catalogue.publisher: EMODnet Human Activities (originators Eurofish International Organisation and Cogea Srl)
catalogue.notes: Port points keyed by UN/LOCODE (as in DfT's port list), georeferenced from Eurostat GISCO 'Ports 2013' where possible, otherwise UN/LOCODE or other sources (recorded per port). Used only for DfT statistical ports without a DfT map location (24 of 51).

catalogue.title: Northern Ireland Railways (NIR) railway network
catalogue.notes: Shapefile in TM75 Irish Grid (EPSG:29903), published 21 September 2015: 34 lines, of which 10 route lines (about 334 km) are drawn and 24 sidings left out. Where the railway runs, not services or freight. Northern Ireland only; Great Britain's railway lines are not in this build.

catalogue.title: OpenStreetMap roads in Northern Ireland (extract provided by John)
catalogue.publisher: OpenStreetMap contributors (extract exported from ArcGIS Pro by John Hewitt)
catalogue.notes: Community-mapped, not official data, used for Northern Ireland's road corridors because DfI's Highway Network has no open geometry and OSNI's open transport layer could not be fetched (John's decision, 26 Oct 2026). Geofabrik roads layer (fclass, ref), WGS84: 251 motorway, 4,016 primary and 6,231 secondary lines; motorways and primary roads kept, merged by road number. © OpenStreetMap contributors.
